user.title: Google Antigravity Usage
user.description:
To sign in with Google, [open the authorization page]({url}) and complete the sign-in. Google will redirect to a localhost URL; copy the complete URL from your browser and paste it into the Authorization Code field below.

For older Antigravity credentials, you can alternatively paste the access-token JSON below.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Google Antigravity
reauth_confirm.description:
Re-authenticate **{name}**. [Open the Google authorization page]({url}) and complete the sign-in. Google will redirect to a localhost URL; copy the complete URL from your browser and paste it into the Authorization Code field below.

You can alternatively paste a fresh legacy access-token JSON below.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Google Cloud Code service
error.exchange_failed: Failed to exchange the authorization code. Paste the complete redirect URL, or try again.
error.missing_credentials: Provide an authorization code, redirect URL, or legacy access token.
